full_judgment: 3. Facts relevant for disposal of the Rules, in brief, are that the predecessors of above opposite party Nos.1-6 and 7-9 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.180 of 1969 (subsequently renumbered as Title Suit No.06 of 1983) in the Court of the then Munsif, Patuakhali. The plaintiffs averred in the said plaint that the disputed suit land originally belong to Golap Khan having kolkorsha right and was owned, held and possessed by him. Golap khan died leaving behind 4 sons namely Osman Khan, Meher Khan, Mochon Khan and Taher Khan and one wife Shahar Vanu as heirs. Osman Khan died leaving his 3 sons namely Entaj Khan, Dhalu Khan and Kalu Khan as heirs. Dhalu Khan died leaving his 2 sons Yousuf Khan and Erfan Khan as heirs. The plaintiffs being the heirs and successive heirs of aforesaid Golap Khan and also by a kabala dated 10.07.1964 had been owning and possessing the entire suit land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.11. It was further contended that during C.S. operation the land was recorded in the name of Golap Khan wrongly showing him as bargadar. Subsequently it was recorded in the name of the defendants erroneously. The plaintiffs came to know about the said erroneous record of right in the defendants' name and hence is the suit for declaration of title and confirmation of possession.
